candidates.title: 2029 elections: Rahul Gandhi is ‘only option’ to take on Modi, says Keralam CM
candidates.excerpt: Keralam Chief Minister V D Satheesan proclaimed that Rahul Gandhi stands as a compelling contender against Prime Minister Modi. Satheesan praised Gandhi's dedication to addressing electoral misconduct, potentially transforming the political dynamics in India. He anticipates that opposition allies will unite under Gandhi's guidance for the upcoming 2029 elections. Furthermore, Satheesan asserted that Gandhi's genuine approach resonates with citizens, reinforcing his position as a potent challenge

candidates.title: 'No complete prohibition...': SC asks Centre to regulate Delhi Metro, other public transport ahead of Oct 10 protest
candidates.excerpt: The Supreme Court directed Delhi authorities not to completely suspend metro services ahead of the 10 October protests. It said operations may be regulated for law and order but commuters must not be left without public transport, and ordered authorities to publicise any restrictions.
